description: Check a receiving domain's DNS now instead of waiting for the automatic check. For a domain added with add_receiving_domain, the first successful verification turns Inbox on (replyTracking.inboundEmailEnabled); domains from an older reply setup or created by update_inbox_address leave it unchanged. Owner or admin only.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

domain.description: Receiving domain name, e.g. support.acme.com, or its receiving domain ID.

name: verify_receiving_domain

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `verify_receiving_domain` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

receivingDomain.description: Receiving domain {id, domain, status (verified|pending|failed), records [{type MX|TXT, name, value, priority?, status}] to publish, error, claimExpiresAt (when an unverified name stops being reserved), verifiedAt, lastCheckedAt, createdAt}.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
